title: Evaluate README Upgrade Prompt
task: In a fictional engineering repository, for this library, lead with the 100 assets and single-dialog copy flow, show one verified composition command, distinguish source modules from composed assets, and state that model effectiveness still requires recorded evaluation.
acceptance_criteria: An audience-to-section map explaining the README hierarchy and removed duplication.
Observed results for every documented setup, verification, composition, build, and development command.
A claim and link audit covering capability, version, license, limitation, examples, docs navigation, and deployed site.
Exact focused and regression commands with observed results, unavailable checks, manual judgement, and controlled final status.
failure_signals: Reject polished README text that outruns verified product behaviour.
Reject duplication of detailed maintained documentation when a clear link is sufficient.
